author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices up and down, finding a special note, echoing short patterns and taking turns, with a German duckling song.

classes.title: Ducks swim up, dip down
classes.goal: Follow the tune as it climbs up the stairs and dips down into the water.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune walks up the stairs, then back down

classes.parentPrompt: Lift your child's arms higher as the tune climbs; dip your heads together at 'heads go in'.
classes.childAction: Paddle your arms, reach up high, then dip your head down.
classes.bridge: Low notes are the water on the left; high notes are the sky.

intro.caption: The ducks swim up, then dip down
intro.parentCue: lift your arms with the tune, then dip

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune go up and down.

classes.title: Paddle, paddle, paddle
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each paddle of the duck's feet.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one paddle of little duck feet: paddle, paddle, paddle.

intro.caption: One paddle, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's hand on each beat first

games.caption: Swimming on the lake
games.parentCue: Paddle your hands together on each tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find the duck's note A
classes.goal: Find A by touch, using the group of three black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys to find one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the three black keys, then down to A between the last two.
classes.childAction: Touch the three black keys, find A, and press it gently.
classes.bridge: A is a little duck nest between the last two of the three black keys.

intro.caption: Find the three black keys
intro.parentCue: let your child touch them first, then find A

games.caption: Three little ducks: A, A, A
games.parentCue: Count 'one, two, three' softly with each press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding one key by its landmark.

classes.title: Quack and quack back
classes.goal: Listen to a short 2 or 3 note call, then play it back the same.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short pattern in mind, then repeating it

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing the call first, then point to your child: your turn.
classes.childAction: Listen to the duck's call, then call it back the same.
classes.bridge: Mama duck quacks first; the duckling quacks it back, same keys, same way.

intro.caption: Mama quacks, baby quacks back
intro.parentCue: listen together first, then let your child copy

games.caption: Heads go down: F, E
games.parentCue: Dip your head on the second note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening, remembering and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Same, same, step down
classes.goal: Notice how each line repeats one note, then steps down, and copy it.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little pattern, moved down like a staircase

classes.parentPrompt: Play the pattern, then point to your child; slide your hand down one step each time.
classes.childAction: Play the same note, then step down to the next key.
classes.bridge: Each line is the duck's same splash, then one step down the stairs.

intro.caption: Same, same, step down
intro.parentCue: show it slowly once, then let your child try

games.caption: Water: F, F, step to E
games.parentCue: Slide your child's hand down one key

games.caption: Air: D, D, step to C
games.parentCue: Same pattern, one more step down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing a pattern that repeats lower.

classes.title: Wait for the A
classes.goal: Wait while the grown-up plays, then play A on 'swimming on the lake'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part, then joining in

classes.parentPrompt: Play your part, then nod to your child just before 'swimming'; smile while they wait.
classes.childAction: Wait for the nod, then press A for 'swim-ming on the'.
classes.bridge: The duck waits on the shore, then jumps into the water: splash on A.

intro.caption: Wait, wait... splash on A!
intro.parentCue: nod to your child when it is their turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a turn, then joining in.

classes.title: Swim side by side
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod the beat with your head; keep going if your child misses.
classes.childAction: Play your A notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two ducks swim side by side, paddling at the same speed.

intro.caption: Two ducks, one beat
intro.parentCue: nod the beat so your child can see it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Duck concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, end on the last note and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song starts on C and comes home to C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note together, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The ducks swim out from home and paddle back to home on C.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
